records.translation: Rikta in en films delningar och jämför dem med matchade kontroller.

records.context: Runs the steps of this module in order. Divisions are read with :func:`division_events`; ``mode='auto'`` keeps whichever kind, fission or budding, the movie has more of. Each division is checked (parent seen at ``t_div`` and on 80% of the window, daughters seen on the next frame, two daughters for a fission). The kept divisions get size-matched controls (:func:`match_controls`) and a shuffled alignment (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) with its own size-matched controls, so the null runs the same matching at a random time. The late-vs-baseline change of every unit (:func:`unit_changes`) is compared as Hedges' g (:func:`effect_size`), dividing against control and shuffled against its control. Complete fission cycles give the size-control fits.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.analyse_divisions#1

The kept divisions get size-matched controls (:func:`match_controls`) and a shuffled alignment (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) with its own size-matched controls, so the null runs the same matching at a random time. records.translation: Kör stegen i den här modulen i ordning. Delningarna läses med :func:`division_events`; ``mode='auto'`` behåller den typ, fission eller knoppning, som filmen har flest av. Varje delning kontrolleras (föräldern syns vid ``t_div`` och i 80% av fönstret, dotterceller syns i nästa bildruta, två dotterceller vid fission). De behållna delningarna får storleksmatchade kontroller (:func:`match_controls`) och en omblandad inriktning (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) med egna storleksmatchade kontroller, så att nollmodellen kör samma matchning vid en slumpmässig tidpunkt. Varje enhets förändring från baslinjefönstret till det sena fönstret (:func:`unit_changes`) jämförs som Hedges' g (:func:`effect_size`): delande mot kontroll och omblandad mot sin kontroll. Fullständiga fissionscykler ger anpassningarna för storleksstyrning.

records.context: A 20X phenotype microscope field of view is not evenly lit: on laboratory microplate A of Funk et al. 2022 the corners receive about half the light of the centre. A cell measured in a corner then reads dimmer than the same cell in the middle, and in a pooled screening experiment, where each guide's cells sit at random positions, that adds noise to every intensity feature and biases the cells near the edge.
records.label: spacr.ops_flatfield#1

A cell measured in a corner then reads dimmer than the same cell in the middle, and in a pooled screen, where each guide's cells sit at random positions, that adds noise to every intensity feature and biases the cells near the edge.
records.translation: Ett fenotypfält vid 20X är inte jämnt belyst: på platta A i Funk et al. 2022 får hörnen ungefär hälften av ljuset i mitten. En cell som mäts i ett hörn ser då mörkare ut än samma cell i mitten, och i en poolad skärm, där varje guides celler sitter på slumpmässiga positioner, ger det brus i varje intensitetsegenskap och snedvrider cellerna nära kanten.

records.context: THE MAP. Per laboratory microplate and channel, a few hundred microscope fields of view are read, block-averaged in 16 x 16 pixel blocks, and the per-block median over the microscope fields of view is taken. Cells move from microscope field of view to microscope field of view while the illumination does not, so the median keeps the illumination and loses the cells. It is smoothed with a Gaussian (sigma 6 blocks, about 96 microscope field of view pixels); the nuclear channel, whose sparse bright nuclei leave a noisier median, is then fitted with a 4th-order 2-D polynomial. The camera and background offset ``b`` is the 0.1th percentile of every block mean, and the map is ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 at the centre. It is floored at 0.25, so no pixel is multiplied by more than 4.
records.label: spacr.ops_flatfield#2
records.source: THE MAP. Per plate and channel, a few hundred fields are read, block-averaged in 16 x 16 pixel blocks, and the per-block median over the fields is taken. Cells move from field to field while the illumination does not, so the median keeps the illumination and loses the cells. It is smoothed with a Gaussian (sigma 6 blocks, about 96 field pixels); the nuclear channel, whose sparse bright nuclei leave a noisier median, is then fitted with a 4th-order 2-D polynomial. The camera and background offset ``b`` is the 0.1th percentile of every block mean, and the map is ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 at the centre. It is floored at 0.25, so no pixel is multiplied by more than 4.
records.translation: KARTAN. Per platta och kanal läses några hundra fält, de blockmedelvärdesbildas i block om 16 x 16 pixlar och medianen per block över fälten tas. Cellerna flyttas från fält till fält medan belysningen inte gör det, så medianen behåller belysningen och tappar cellerna. Den jämnas ut med en gaussisk kärna (sigma 6 block, omkring 96 fältpixlar); kärnkanalen, vars glesa ljusa kärnor ger en brusigare median, anpassas sedan med ett 2-D-polynom av 4:e ordningen. Kamerans och bakgrundens förskjutning ``b`` är 0.1-percentilen av alla blockmedelvärden, och kartan är ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 i mitten. Den har ett golv på 0.25, så ingen pixel multipliceras med mer än 4.

records.context: Core ownership by the sequencing centroid (A1b). A nucleus imaged in two overlapping phenotype microscope fields of view is kept from the microscope field of view in which its sequencing centroid lies deepest, not from the closer match (:func:`deduplicate_matches`). The closer match is often the margin copy, and a margin copy is more often cut by the microscope field of view's edge: on laboratory microplate A of Funk et al. 2022 the closer match kept a different copy for 14.4 percent of linked cells. Equal depths go to the closer match, then to the first row.
records.label: spacr.ops_merge.deepest_field_matches#6
records.source: CORE OWNERSHIP BY THE SEQUENCING CENTROID (A1b). A nucleus imaged in two overlapping phenotype fields is kept from the field in which its sequencing centroid lies deepest, not from the closer match (:func:`deduplicate_matches`). The closer match is often the margin copy, and a margin copy is more often cut by the field's edge: on plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the closer match kept a different copy for 14.4 percent of linked cells. Equal depths go to the closer match, then to the first row.
records.translation: KÄRNÄGARSKAP GENOM SEKVENSERINGSCENTROIDEN (A1b). En kärna som avbildats i två överlappande fenotypfält behålls från det fält där dess sekvenseringscentroid ligger djupast inne, inte från den närmare matchningen (:func:`deduplicate_matches`). Den närmare matchningen är ofta kopian i marginalen, och en kopia i marginalen skärs oftare av fältets kant: på platta A i Funk et al. 2022 behöll den närmare matchningen en annan kopia för 14.4 procent av de länkade cellerna. Lika djup går till den närmare matchningen och sedan till den första raden.
